:root{--bg:#f4efe8;--ink:#17130f;--muted:#786f67;--card:#fffaf4;--line:#ded3c7;--accent:#8d5d42}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fffaf4,#eee3d7);color:var(--ink);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif}.app-shell{max-width:760px;margin:auto;padding:20px 14px 36px}header{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:10px 2px 20px}.brand{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--ink);color:white;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 30px Georgia}small{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em}h1,h2{margin:4px 0}header p,.host p{color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0}.host,.chat,.info{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 12px 35px #2a1a0d0d}.host{padding:18px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:70px 1fr auto;gap:14px;align-items:center}.avatar{width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#d7b28e,#8d5d42);display:grid;place-items:center;color:white;font:700 30px Georgia}.host button,.voice button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:white;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;cursor:pointer}nav{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow:auto;padding:12px 0}nav button{white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fffaf4;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 13px;cursor:pointer}.chat{padding:14px}.msg{max-width:92%;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:18px;margin:8px 0;line-height:1.7}.bot{background:#f0e6db;margin-left:auto}.user{background:var(--ink);color:white;margin-right:auto}.msg b{font-size:10px;color:var(--accent)}.msg p{margin:3px 0;white-space:pre-line}.voice{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 0 0;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}.voice span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:8px;margin-top:9px}input{min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:12px;font:inherit}form button{border:0;background:var(--ink);color:white;border-radius:14px;padding:0 18px}.actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-top:12px}.actions a{padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:#fffaf4;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}.actions span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:3px}.info{margin-top:12px;padding:15px}.info p{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:9px}.info p:last-child{border:0}footer{margin-top:16px;color:#95897f;font-size:10px;text-align:center}@media(max-width:520px){h1{font-size:26px}.host{grid-template-columns:60px 1fr auto}.avatar{width:60px;height:60px}.actions{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
